transcript: R1 -- IMPERFECT-ENGLISH COMPREHENSION: multi-cue Competition-Model parser vs order-only parser
Ground truth for every item: an ANIMATE agent acts on an INANIMATE patient.
The order-only parser assigns roles by WORD POSITION alone, so degraded order -> inverted roles.
The multi-cue parser COMPETES position against animacy + verb-fit (learned validity) -> robust.
INPUT: "apple eat dog"   [object-fronted (patient first)]
ground truth        :  agent=dog    patient=apple
order-only parser   :  agent=apple  patient=dog    -> WRONG (roles inverted)
multi-cue parser    :  agent=dog    patient=apple  -> CORRECT
behavioral readout  :  who_does("apple")?  order-only=None   multi-cue=dog      (truth=dog)
INPUT: "ball kick cat"   [object-fronted (patient first)]
ground truth        :  agent=cat    patient=ball
order-only parser   :  agent=ball   patient=cat    -> WRONG (roles inverted)
multi-cue parser    :  agent=cat    patient=ball   -> CORRECT
behavioral readout  :  who_does("ball")?  order-only=None   multi-cue=cat      (truth=cat)
INPUT: "bone dog bite"   [scrambled + dropped function words (verb last)]
ground truth        :  agent=dog    patient=bone
order-only parser   :  agent=bone   patient=bite   -> WRONG (roles inverted)
multi-cue parser    :  agent=dog    patient=bone   -> CORRECT
behavioral readout  :  who_does("bone")?  order-only=None   multi-cue=dog      (truth=dog)
INPUT: "rock fox push"   [scrambled + dropped function words (verb last)]
ground truth        :  agent=fox    patient=rock
order-only parser   :  agent=rock   patient=push   -> WRONG (roles inverted)
multi-cue parser    :  agent=fox    patient=rock   -> CORRECT
behavioral readout  :  who_does("rock")?  order-only=None   multi-cue=fox      (truth=fox)
CANONICAL CONTROL: "wolf carry stick" (native SVO)  -> multi-cue parse CORRECT, order-only parse CORRECT  (the multi-cue parser does not break the native case)
NO-CONFAB MOAT (an UNKNOWN-subject / unstored-relation query must abstain -> None):
what_does("stick", "carry")  order-only=None   multi-cue=None    (both must be None)
who_does("chase", "bird") order-only=None   multi-cue=None    (both must be None)
-> moat HELD (zero confabulation, both agents)
SUMMARY
multi-cue parser  : 4/4 imperfect sentences comprehended CORRECTLY (behavioral who/what 4/4)
order-only parser : 0/4 imperfect sentences comprehended CORRECTLY (behavioral who/what 0/4)
canonical control : multi-cue PASS (native word order not broken)
no-confab moat    : HELD in BOTH agents
-> DEMO PASS: multi-cue (4/4) beats order-only (0/4) on imperfect English, moat intact
